card.name: Diagnosis and nonspecific-symptom wording
card.fires_on: Words inside or just after terms about diagnosis, nonspecific symptoms, test specificity, or CNS depressants, such as misdiagnosed, non-specific, specificity and depressants. It also fires on the verb died after infected counts.

modes.label: Nonspecific / specificity

modes.label: Misdiagnosis wording
modes.description: Parts of misdiagnosed or empiric, or the word as after misdiagnosed.
modes.example: Lyme disease is often misdiagnosed<< as>> fibromyalgia, rheumatoid

modes.label: CNS depressants
modes.description: The ending of the phrase CNS depressant(s) after benzodiazepines.
modes.example: benzodiazepines or other CNS depress<<ant>>, including alcohol
